children: General Mills reported fiscal 2027 first-quarter results with net sales of $4.39 billion, down 3% year-over-year, and operating profit of $634 million. Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.75 (down 13% in constant currency) while reported diluted EPS was $0.74. The company reaffirmed its full-year fiscal 2027 outlook, including adjusted diluted earnings of $3.00–$3.20 and at least $750 million of cost savings from productivity and transformation programs.
Net sales: $4,389.5 million for the quarter, down 3% versus prior year (impact primarily from U.S. yogurt divestiture).
Gross margin: 33.9% of net sales; adjusted gross margin: 33.3% (down 90 basis points).
Operating profit: $633.6 million (reported), down 63% year-over-year; adjusted operating profit: $634.0 million (down 11% in constant currency).
Net earnings attributable to General Mills: $397.0 million; diluted EPS (reported): $0.74.
Adjusted diluted EPS: $0.75 for the quarter (down 13% in constant currency); company reaffirmed fiscal 2027 adjusted diluted EPS guidance of $3.00–$3.20.
Organic net sales were essentially flat for the quarter after excluding divestitures and currency effects; consolidated organic growth matched prior-year levels.

North America Retail: net sales down 7% (including a 4-point headwind from the U.S. yogurt divestiture); organic net sales down 3%, with sequential improvement in retail sales growth and strengthening dollar share in priority categories.
North America Pet: net sales flat at $613 million; organic net sales flat and outpaced all-channel retail sales by ~1 point due to calendar alignment from the Whitebridge acquisition.
North America Foodservice: net sales up 1%, organic net sales up 4% led by cereal and frozen meals; segment gained or held share across priority businesses.
International: net sales up 4% with organic growth of 4% driven by distributor markets, India, and China; segment operating profit increased and media investment rose double digits.
Completed sale of Brazil business subsequent to quarter end (Sept. 2, 2026); company recorded non-cash valuation losses while assets were held for sale during the quarter.
Continued execution of Holistic Margin Management and global Transformation initiatives, targeting at least $750 million in fiscal 2027 savings to offset input inflation and fund brand investments.
